description: Ethics pack for the Windows laptop (Intel Lunar Lake + Arc iGPU, Ollama, local judge): the 3B cross-family pair from the laptop profile decides dilemmas with prices attached — colony caretaking, triage, rescue dispatch, confidentiality vs safety, generation-ship policy, and whistleblowing. Each scenario carries its own local qwen3:8b judge with criteria tailored to its dilemma, grading the decision record: consistency as the price rises, honesty about costs, engagement. The profile supplies the contestants and duel settings only, so the scenarios' judges survive.
